messages:
alex: Quick note — starting a small enablement sprint to produce partner deployment blueprints + an IaC starter kit (TF modules, example apps, and CI smoke harness). Goal: ship a repo partners/cloud-deploy-blueprints with AWS/GCP/Azure examples by EOW.

maria: 👍 can we standardize variable names and outputs? I want minimal surface area for customers. propose vars: region, instance_type, network_cidr, kms_key_id.

jun: I can take module testing. I'll add terratest + GitHub actions. we should include a tiny e2e that launches a single node and hits /health.

kevin: Also add packaging notes for cloud marketplaces — they require ARM/x86 images listed, license info, and a manifest. I'll draft a checklist.

partner-eng: Partner asked for prescriptive networking: sample VPC peering, cross-account route table snippet, and KMS envelope key pattern. They also want an example for private endpoint + NAT config.

alex: Good. Let's avoid huge examples. Keep a "simple" and an "hardened" blueprint per cloud. Simple = 1 subnet, public LB, single instance. Hardened = multi-AZ, private subnets, KMS, SIEM hooks.

maria: We should provide a common module interface so examples just wire modules together. e.g. a root module that calls modules/network, modules/compute, modules/observability.

jun: Agreed. draft terraform usage snippet:

```hcl
module "redwood_compute" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-modules.git//modules/compute?ref=main"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  tags = {team = "partnerx"}
}
```

kevin: Keep provider aliases in examples so customers can see multi-account setup. also include a note about provider version pinning.

partner-eng: For marketplace packaging I'll add sample manifest.json and a short script to produce the artifact. also want a one-page architecture diagram (PNG + text alt).

ops-bot: ticket created: EN-2147 "partner deploy blueprints repo + marketplace packaging" (assignee: @alex).

alex: Action items: @maria to write variable/output conventions + template README, @jun to add terratest CI and smoke e2e, @kevin to draft marketplace checklist and manifest example, @partner-eng to provide network/KMS patterns and diagram. I'll wire up repo skeleton and skeleton PR.

maria: I'll drop a README template in /docs/blueprint-guidelines.md and link to naming conventions.

jun: I'll aim to open the terratest PR by tomorrow. will include GH actions matrix for aws/gcp.

kevin: Draft manifest coming in a few hours. will include sample license and acceptance tests section.

partner-eng: Sending over a rough diagram and network snippets in this thread in ~2h.

alex: Great — thanks all. keeping this thread for async updates. ping here with PR links. :rocket:
